row.IncomeRule: City main-building levels supply 500, 750, 1000 Astrology Points per day respectively; skills, faction laws and scenario settings can modify income. Accumulated points grant Insight. The installed build contains several threshold tables, so no universal first threshold or fixed increment is asserted.
row.UnlockRule: Spend Insight in the Magic Observatory to learn eligible high Neutral spells for the kingdom. Heroes must satisfy the spell's own level requirement. Insight can also be gained from an Altar of Insight. This is the build-25061458 system described by its tutorial.
row.UpgradeRule: Spend the spell's defined Insight upgrade cost to improve supported Global Map spells, up to the spell's available level. The source's starDust learn/upgrade costs identify Insight; this is separate from ordinary school-spell research and Alchemical Dust upgrades.

evidence.claim: The same-build tutorial directly connects city Astrology Point income, accumulated Insight, and spending Insight to learn or upgrade high Neutral Global Map spells. Threshold definitions are variants, not one constant-increment series.

row.ProgressionRule: Mage Guilds unlock ordinary school spells; their mastery skill allows high-tier learning. Observatory upgrades use Alchemical Dust. Effective spell levels are capped at four. Astrology's Insight progression applies to high Neutral spells, not this regular school.

evidence.claim: UsesAstrology means the school has spells governed by the build's Astrology/Insight progression, not that every spell requires it. Regular-school progression and high Neutral progression are separate.

sources.scope: Selected primary definitions are hashed on every action. The Steam manifest's installed buildid was checked; queued TargetBuildID is not used.
Corroborates four regular-school constellations, five tiers and four effective spell levels; build-specific Astrology rules use installed tutorial instead of newer neutral-progression text.

held.reason: Unknown support flags and map level counts remain null. The installed .map header stores session defaults, not all supported modes; no false flags are invented.
Trade/mine true flags are sourced. Negative flags and persistence remain null pending explicit contract and source evidence.
Five differently shaped build threshold tables are retained in evidence; active selection is not established and the progression is not one fixed increment.
Tutorial_Mission_1 advertises difficulty index 1 but all supplied variant difficulty records use index 0. StartingState stays null rather than guessing which record the engine selects.
Objectives, mission rules and supported starting treasuries are summarized. Optional Scripts stay null; raw mission scripts are not copied into catalog JSON.
